_about: Garathorm Inner City: a living city, no boss. The watch walks the main streets, and an attack on any citizen, shopkeeper or guard brings the watch running (helpers group garathorm_watch: citizens call, guards come). Townsfolk fill the streets.

30500.name: watchman garathorm watch
30500.long_desc: A watchman of Garathorm walks his beat, halberd on his shoulder.
30500.description: Steel cap, blue tabard with the city's tower, a halberd and a whistle on a cord. The watch keeps the peace of the streets, and they come quickly when that whistle blows.

helpers.shout: The watchman blows a shrill whistle: the watch is coming!

30501.name: lamplighter
30501.long_desc: The lamplighter carries his long pole and a can of oil from lamp to lamp.
30501.description: A stooped old man in a soot-streaked coat, his pole tipped with a brass hook and a smouldering wick. He knows every lamp in the city by name.

helpers.shout: Guards! Guards! To me, the watch!

30502.name: town crier
30502.long_desc: The town crier rings his handbell and calls out the news of the day.
30502.description: A barrel-chested man in a red coat with a bell in one hand and a scroll of notices in the other. His voice carries across the whole square.

helpers.shout: Guards! Guards! To me, the watch!

30503.name: porter
30503.long_desc: A merchants' porter staggers past under a load of crates.
30503.description: Broad in the shoulder and short of breath, the porter carries goods from the quay to the shops for a few coppers a load.

helpers.shout: Guards! Guards! To me, the watch!

30504.name: urchin street
30504.long_desc: A street urchin darts between the passers-by, eyeing purses.
30504.description: Barefoot, quick and grubby, with a grin missing two teeth. The urchins of the Dark Alley know every shortcut in the city.

helpers.shout: Guards! Guards! To me, the watch!

30505.name: flower seller
30505.long_desc: A flower seller offers posies from a basket on her arm.
30505.description: A young woman in a patched shawl with a basket of violets, marigolds and sprigs of lavender from the park.

helpers.shout: Guards! Guards! To me, the watch!

30506.name: pilgrim
30506.long_desc: A pilgrim in a dusty cloak has come far to pray at the Temple.
30506.description: Road-worn boots, a staff, and a pilgrim's badge pinned to a hood. They have walked a long way to see the Temple of Garathorm.

helpers.shout: Guards! Guards! To me, the watch!

30507.name: temple guard
30507.long_desc: A temple guard stands watch beside the altar, spear grounded.
30507.description: A tall guard in a white surcoat over mail, the temple's sun stitched on the breast. He keeps the peace among the pilgrims and the newly arrived, and watches the doors more than the altar.

helpers.shout: Guards! To the temple!

30507.why: the temple is kept: a guard by the altar
